title: Amazingly Aromatic Canadian Chocolate Bake
description: A comforting Canadian dish featuring lemon zest and tempering chocolate, this herbal and chewy bake is perfect for a cold evening, and is shojin-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the rolled oats, brown sugar, dried cranberries, and chopped walnuts.
In a separate bowl, melt the coconut oil and tempered dark chocolate in the microwave or over a double boiler.
Add the vanilla extract and lemon zest to the melted chocolate mixture and stir until combined.
Pour the chocolate mixture over the oat mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Press the mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely before cutting into squares.
